title: Introduce graceful chunk iterator and per-call retry profiles for streaming ergonomics
author: Soraya Patel
description: Motivation: Improve developer ergonomics for chunked streaming use-cases and provide switchable per-call retry profiles without forcing a global SDK policy. This PR adds a first-class ChunkedStream iterator (ChunkIterator) that yields small typed Fragment objects, stabilizes timeout/abort behavior across sync/async consumers, and introduces a per-call retryProfile option (e.g. 'latency_sensitive', 'throughput', 'best_effort') that maps to pre-configured retry windows and backoff settings. The change is targeted at TypeScript SDK consumers but includes clear coordination notes for companion PRs in Python and Go (see linked Linear tasks). Goals: 1) Make streaming consumption ergonomic when applications want to process partial tokens/blocks as typed fragments. 2) Allow request-level retry profiles so callers can choose tighter latency budgets or more aggressive retries on a per-call basis. 3) Ensure the iterator gracefully signals transient failures while exposing a simple resume() API for resumable application logic. Implementation summary: - Add src/stream/chunk_iterator.ts: new async iterator abstraction that returns Fragment objects, supports pause()/resume(), and emits structured error tokens for transient failures. - Add src/types/fragment.ts: small, well-documented Fragment interface with metadata (offset, isFinal, chunkType). - Add retryProfiles config in SDK client with default mapping for three profiles; tie per-call option to underlying request dispatcher. - Normalize abort-signal handling so both sync and async consumers receive the same cancellation semantics and underlying socket timeouts are translated into retryable errors when appropriate. - Add unit tests and integration tests that exercise resume semantics and per-call retry toggles. - Bump package to 2.4.0 and add release notes. Compatibility notes: This is additive for consumers; existing streaming APIs continue to work. The per-call retryProfile key is optional and defaults to the SDK's previous behavior. There is a small behavioral change: transient socket timeouts are now surfaced as retryable errors by default (previously surfaced as terminal errors in a small subset of edge cases). To mitigate surprises, the SDK logs a single informational message when the new mapping is used the first time per process. Migration: Consumers that currently rely on the earlier terminal timeout should opt out by setting retryProfile: 'best_effort' or explicitly set retry options on the client. Companion PRs and follow-ups: ENG-5138 & ENG-5146 track the cross-language spec and compatibility tests; Python and Go PRs will mirror the iterator interface and profile names.
